verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an in-dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether that assistant can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The pack has no evidence that it, or any other part of Supabase, can connect to third-party MCP servers and use their tools. All MCP evidence covers the server role: Supabase's own hosted and local MCP server, plus hosting your own MCP servers on Edge Functions. None of that is client-side capability, so it is not credited here.
